resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Danish source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, route checks, and generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Danish pass identified 25 remaining circuit, TCR, thermal, SI-conversion, and wire-gauge wording issues; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Danish human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The resistance example title used an imperative without the definite noun.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Find modstand’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Find modstanden’.

findings.summary: The voltage example title used an indefinite noun.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Find spænding’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Find spændingen’.

findings.summary: The constant-resistance statement used an awkward production construction.
evidence: The previous bullet said that doubling current ‘producerer’ four times heat effect.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it as a direct Danish relationship using ‘giver ... fire gange så stor varmeeffekt’.

findings.summary: The constant-current statement repeated the doubling phrase awkwardly.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘fordobler en fordobling’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘varmeeffekten fordobles, når modstanden fordobles’.

findings.summary: The constant-voltage statement used an unnatural noun phrase for lowering resistance.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘sænkning af modstand’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘når modstanden sænkes’.

findings.summary: The series-cell explanation did not clearly state the ampere-hour relationship.
evidence: The previous bullet said capacity remained ‘den samme som en celle’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it to state that capacity in ampere-hours is approximately that of one cell.

findings.summary: The lithium-ion series-charging bullet used a compressed compound that was hard to read.
evidence: The previous bullet used ‘Serielithium-ion-opladning’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to clear Danish for charging series-connected lithium-ion cells.

findings.summary: The circuit-analysis title used the less natural phrase rigtige kredsløb.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Løsning af rigtige kredsløb’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Analyse af virkelige kredsløb’.

findings.summary: The circuit-analysis checklist used nodespændinger instead of the standard Danish knude term.
evidence: The previous bullet began ‘Marker nodespændinger’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Markér knudespændinger’ and retained the branch-current checklist.

findings.summary: The final checklist item needed a more polished conjunction and imperative.
evidence: The previous item joined the two instructions without a comma or clear verb form.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Løs de samtidige ligninger, og kontrollér effektbalancen’.

findings.summary: The constant-voltage TCR paragraph used compressed syntax for the temperature and current effects.
evidence: The previous paragraph used ‘stigende temperatur’ and ‘modstandsforøgelse’ in a literal construction.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with explicit positive-TCR, constant-voltage, and constant-current relationships.

findings.summary: The manufacturer-range limitation used a vague phrase for the first-order estimate.
evidence: The previous paragraph ended with ‘førsteordens skøn’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with the more precise term ‘førsteordensestimatet’ and clearer source limitations.

findings.summary: The angular-frequency unit used the abbreviated and less natural ‘pr.’ form.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘radianer pr. sekund’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘radianer i sekundet’.

findings.summary: The object/material title used kontra, which was less natural in this technical context.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Objekt kontra materiale’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Objekt og materiale’.

findings.summary: The temperature-difference equivalence used an awkward phrase for equal magnitude.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘den samme størrelse som’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the natural Danish phrase ‘lige så stor som’.

findings.summary: The area-conversion instruction omitted the definite article and used a less direct command.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘Konverter areal’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Konvertér arealet til m², før du bruger W/m²’.

findings.summary: The inch conversion formula retained English unit names and decimal points.
evidence: The previous formula began ‘1 inch = 25.4 mm’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to Danish unit wording and decimal commas.

findings.summary: The foot conversion formula retained English unit names and decimal points.
evidence: The previous formula began ‘1 foot = 12 inches’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘1 fod = 12 tommer = 0,3048 m’.

findings.summary: The yard conversion formula retained English foot wording and decimal points.
evidence: The previous formula began ‘1 yard = 3 feet’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘1 yard = 3 fod = 0,9144 m’.

findings.summary: The AWG description used a literal and grammatically awkward expansion.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘den amerikanske Wire Gauge’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘AWG er American Wire Gauge’.

findings.summary: The diameter instruction used a reflexive phrase suggesting that systems themselves become confused.
evidence: The previous bullet said ‘når systemer kan blive forvirrede’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘når systemerne kan forveksles’.

findings.summary: The conductor-dimension instruction used an incomplete noun phrase.
evidence: The previous bullet did not clearly state whether the dimension applied to a bare conductor.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with clear Danish for bare conductor, insulation, sheet thickness, and pipe-wall thickness.

findings.summary: The system-comparison paragraph used identify for a relation that should use correspond.
evidence: The previous sentence said the same number ‘identificerer’ the same diameter.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the clearer correspondence wording ‘svarer ... til samme diameter’.

findings.summary: The resistance explanation used a literal phrase for a small diameter difference and an unclear AWG verb.
evidence: The previous paragraph used ‘beskeden diameterforskel’ and ‘forøgelse af måleren’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with a clear small-difference statement and the three-gauge relationship.

findings.summary: The imperial-dimension note retained English words inches, square inches, and cubic inches.
evidence: The previous paragraph ended with the untranslated English dimension names.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘tommer, kvadrattommer og kubiktommer’.
